comment: win/tty/wintty.c process_menu_window() (1554-1561, 1637-1642). menu_first_page:& maps '&' to MENU_FIRST_PAGE, '^', which is also the group accelerator of the '/' menu's "nearby traps" entry. '&' is not an explicit choice, so map_menu_cmd() turns it into '^' and the MENU_FIRST_PAGE arm runs: on the only page it does nothing and the menu stays, twice. The raw '^' is found in resp[] before resp_len, so it is MENU_EXPLICIT_CHOICE and picks the traps entry. Seed, date, dwarvish Cavewoman and keys chosen independently.
